facts.text: Driver-in-the-loop or operator-in-the-loop testing puts a real person in a simulator cab with screens, controls and sometimes motion to study operator reactions when a machine warns, waits and then brakes.
facts.quote: Driver-in-the-loop or operator-in-the-loop testing puts a real person in a simulator cab, with screens, controls and sometimes motion, to study how operators react when the machine warns, waits and then brakes.

facts.text: Operator-training machine simulators can present a warning, a delay and an automatic stop while recording operators' hands and feet, eye movements and comments.
facts.quote: can present a warning, a delay and then an automatic stop, while recording the operator's hands and feet, eye movements and comments.

facts.text: Operator simulator studies can investigate warning timing, surprise caused by automatic intervention, nuisance-warning workload, simultaneous manual braking, override behavior, trust and understanding of the interface.
facts.quote: warning timing, whether automatic intervention surprises the operator, nuisance-warning workload, simultaneous manual braking, override behavior, trust and understanding of the interface [Chapter 1].

facts.text: A University of Queensland and Australian Coal Association Research Program (ACARP) project used a haul-truck simulator around 2017 to evaluate visual and sound proximity interfaces for advisory warnings, not automatic braking.
facts.quote: A University of Queensland and ACARP (Australian Coal Association Research Program) project used a haul-truck simulator (about 2017) to evaluate visual and sound proximity interfaces, but for advisory warnings, not automatic braking;

facts.text: No off-road study of operators experiencing automatic braking in a simulator was found.
facts.quote: no off-road study of operators experiencing automatic braking in a simulator was found [Chapter 1].

facts.text: Road-vehicle simulator studies found that warnings with 20 to 33% false alarms still shortened brake reaction times.
facts.quote: Road-vehicle simulator studies found that warnings with 20 to 33% false alarms still shortened brake reaction times

facts.text: Road-vehicle simulator studies found that drivers who trusted other vehicles' automatic braking braked later.
facts.quote: drivers who trusted other vehicles' automatic braking braked later [Chapter 4].

facts.text: No validated operator model for off-road machines exists.
facts.quote: No validated operator model for off-road machines exists

facts.text: Mining studies use fixed operator reaction delays.
facts.quote: mining studies use fixed reaction delays [Chapter 4].

facts.text: Human-in-the-loop simulators at research institutes and machine manufacturers are identified as possible resources for operator studies.
facts.quote: The booklet names human-in-the-loop simulators at research institutes and machine manufacturers as possible resources [Chapter 11].

facts.text: Operator simulators cannot validate real sensors or brakes.
facts.quote: Simulators cannot validate real sensors or brakes

facts.text: Operator simulators cannot reproduce motion cues perfectly.
Operator simulators cannot reveal long-term complacency and risk compensation after months of nuisance interventions.
facts.quote: or reveal long-term complacency and risk compensation after months of nuisance interventions [Chapter 1].

facts.text: The collision-mitigation validation program schedules operator studies before prototype safety testing to avoid discovering basic interface problems during expensive machine tests.
facts.quote: The booklet schedules operator studies before prototype safety testing, so that basic interface problems are not discovered during expensive machine tests

facts.text: Human performance can change both positively and negatively after technology is introduced.
